<action type="say">
Once a card is reported lost and blocked in this system, I can’t reverse it or stop the replacement here.

What’s likely true right now:
- Your original Student Card ending in 7777 is permanently blocked and shouldn’t be used, even though you found it.
- A replacement card (ACC-001-R1) is already in process to be sent, estimated arrival 2026-08-04.

To try to change this, you’ll need to contact the bank directly (phone or in-app chat). When you do, tell them:
1) “My card ending in 7777 was reported lost but I’ve found it.”
2) Ask: “Can you:
   - confirm the current status of the card,
   - cancel the replacement card ACC-001-R1 if it hasn’t shipped yet, and
   - (if their policy allows) reactivate my original card so I can keep using it?”

Policies vary: some banks never reactivate a card once it’s been marked lost, and some can cancel the replacement if it hasn’t been produced/shipped yet.

If you tell me how you usually contact the bank (phone vs. app), I can draft a short message or call script you can use word-for-word.</action>
